Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let b G be a connected semisimple complex algebraic group, and let r : Wk → b G be a Frobenius-semisimple Weil parameter with finite inertial image. Write e = Lie( b G)r(Ik) , ea = ker Ad(r(Fr)) − a | e  (a ∈ C× ), 8 and let C = Zb G (r(Wk)). If (r, N) is a Weil–Deligne parameter and L(s, Ad ◦(r, N)) is regular at s = 1, then the orbit C · N is open in eQ−1 . In particular, if N1, N2 are two monodromy operators over r whose adjoint L-factors are regular at 1, then some c ∈ C satisfies Ad(c)N1 = N2.
